numbers.name: CMB part of chi2 LCDM / CPL / UET
CPL best (Omega_m, w0, wa, omega_b, omega_m)

note: PASS under Test Card T041 (approved 75ded3d26 before the data were opened), at the edge: dchi2_CPL = 3.94 against the PASS limit 4. Single run, 76 min. Adding the CMB moved the UET family from dchi2_CPL = 0.03 (T040) to 3.94: CPL now gains 5.4 in chi2 over LCDM, the UET family only 1.5. The UET best point sits on two edges of the AI grid (xi_c = 0.05, the largest value; psi_i = 0.1, the smallest), so a wider grid may lower chi2_UET; that would only move the outcome further from FAIL. Each UET point was fitted with at most 400 Nelder-Mead evaluations. Background only: distance priors (R, l_A, omega_b) of Chen et al. 2019 stand in for the full CMB likelihood. Not UET-distinct: thawing and extended quintessence give the same family. Recorded at L1 with outcome PASS; it becomes L2_CONFRONTED, and the claim with it, only when the author approves (approval block added then).
